title: Lesson 71 · A famous clock
titleZh: 第71课 一个著名的大钟

examples.en: Big Ben is a famous clock.
examples.zh: 大本钟是一座著名的钟。

examples.en: The great clock is very accurate.
When you visit London, you will see Big Ben.
examples.zh: 你游览伦敦时，会看到大本钟。

examples.en: London is the capital of Britain.
Big Ben can be heard on the BBC.
examples.zh: 通过英国广播公司能听到大本钟的钟声。

examples.en: The Houses of Parliament were burned down in 1834.
The great clock was erected after 1834.
examples.zh: 这座大钟是1834年后建造的。

examples.en: He was responsible for the making of the clock.
The clock is of immense size.
Officials have the clock checked twice a day.
examples.zh: 官员们每天派人校对两次钟。

examples.en: The officials come from Greenwich Observatory.
examples.zh: 这些官员来自格林尼治天文台。

examples.en: You can hear the clock striking on the BBC.
examples.zh: 你能通过英国广播公司听到钟声敲响。

examples.en: Microphones are connected to the clock tower.
A painter slowed the clock down.
examples.zh: 一个油漆工把钟弄慢了。

examples.en: He hung a pot of paint on one of the hands.
examples.zh: 他把一罐油漆挂在了一根指针上。

examples.en: The pot was full of paint.

sentences.en: When you visit London, one of the first things you will see is Big Ben.
sentences.zh: 你游览伦敦时，最先看到的景物之一就是大本钟。

sentences.en: It is not only of immense size, but it is extremely accurate as well.
sentences.zh: 它不仅体积巨大，而且走时极其准确。

sentences.en: Officials from Greenwich Observatory have the clock checked twice a day.
sentences.zh: 格林尼治天文台的官员们每天派人把钟校对两次。

sentences.en: You can hear the clock on the BBC when it is actually striking.
sentences.zh: 当钟真正敲响的时候，你能通过英国广播公司听到钟声。

sentences.en: Big Ben has rarely gone wrong, but once it failed to give the correct time.
sentences.zh: 大本钟很少出差错，但有一次它没能给出准确的时间。

article.en: When you visit London, one of the first things you will see is Big Ben.
article.zh: 你游览伦敦时，最先看到的景物之一就是大本钟。

article.en: Big Ben is the famous clock which can be heard all over the world on the BBC.
article.zh: 大本钟是那座著名的钟，全世界都能通过英国广播公司听到它的钟声。

article.en: If the Houses of Parliament had not been burned down in 1834, the great clock would never have been erected.
article.zh: 如果不是国会大厦在1834年被烧毁，这座大钟也许永远不会被建造。

article.en: Big Ben takes its name from Sir Benjamin Hall, who was responsible for the making of the clock.
article.zh: 大本钟得名于本杰明·霍尔爵士，他负责了这座钟的制造。

article.en: It is not only of immense size, but it is extremely accurate as well.
article.zh: 它不仅体积巨大，而且走时极其准确。

article.en: Officials from Greenwich Observatory have the clock checked twice a day.
article.zh: 格林尼治天文台的官员们每天派人把钟校对两次。

article.en: You can hear the clock on the BBC when it is actually striking.
article.zh: 当钟真正敲响的时候，你能通过英国广播公司听到钟声。

article.en: Big Ben has rarely gone wrong, but once it failed to give the correct time.
article.zh: 大本钟很少出差错，但有一次它没能给出准确的时间。

article.en: A painter had hung a pot of paint on one of the hands and slowed it down!
article.zh: 一个油漆工把一罐油漆挂在了其中一根指针上，把它弄慢了！
